# Navigation fixtures and supported static input

The executable fixtures live in `tests/test_navigation.lua`: each creates actual files in an isolated temporary directory and invokes the production adapter, model, reading order, and provider. Run `nvim --headless -u NONE -l tests/run.lua`.

This implementation uses project-owned Lua parsers, with no vendored code or new runtime dependencies. It does not execute project JS/TS, Python, SSG builds, or MDX components. `require.resolve('literal')` is recognized lexically as the literal path; no module resolution executes.

## Parser boundary

YAML supports indentation-based maps/sequences, continued sequence maps, indentless sequences under mapping keys, ordered maps, quoted keys/scalars, comments outside strings, scalar booleans/numbers/null, and flow arrays/maps. It rejects tags, anchors, aliases, merge keys, duplicate keys, tabs in indentation, and multiple documents. Simple block strings are accepted; advanced YAML scalar folding/chomping is not a compatibility guarantee. Source rows are stored in ordered-map metatables and diagnostics.

TOML supports table and array-table headers, dotted keys, quoted keys/strings, basic escapes, booleans/numbers, multiline arrays, inline maps, and comments. Date/time values, multiline quoted strings, and arbitrary expressions are rejected. Frontmatter accepts a single fenced YAML (`---`) or TOML (`+++`) block and offsets diagnostics to the source document.

SUMMARY preserves ordered headings, plain/prefix/suffix links, list hierarchy, empty link destinations, optional link titles, source positions, Unicode, spaces, and anchors. Reference-style links and multiline inline labels are diagnosed instead of silently included. Adapters apply different heading/draft semantics.

Static JS/TS supports literal arrays/objects with comments, quoted or identifier keys, numbers/strings/booleans/null, trailing commas, `module.exports`, `export default`, literal `const`/`let` bindings, simple type annotations, type imports, `as const`, and `satisfies Type`. Calls, spread, computed keys, template strings and imported/computed values are rejected. Framework option extraction reads a literal `docs` property or `starlight({...})` argument without executing wrappers. Unrelated framework configuration is not evaluated.

## Adapter boundary

| Adapter | Implemented and covered by fixtures | Explicit limitations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mdBook | `book.toml`, `book.src`, SUMMARY, part headings, prefix/suffix, nested chapters, drafts, missing files | Preprocessors do not run; generated chapters require a provider |
| HonKit | Static `book.json`, `root`, `structure.summary`, nested chapters, valid empty summary | `book.js` is unsupported; plugin-generated navigation needs a provider |
| GitBook | `gitbook-docs.yaml` site structure, nested sections/spaces, per-space `.gitbook.yaml` root/summary, heading groups, custom link label, unavailable unsynced spaces | No cloud fetch; redirect rules are diagnosed, not applied; duplicate document occurrences are diagnosed |
| MkDocs | Ordered static `nav`, nested groups, external URLs, `docs_dir`, valid empty nav | INHERIT/plugins are diagnosed; no-nav filesystem order is explicitly `inferred` |
| Zensical | `[project]` TOML with nested inline nav arrays/maps and docs root, or MkDocs-compatible YAML nav | Same static-nav limitations; YAML alone deliberately yields both MkDocs and Zensical candidates |
| Docusaurus | Static sidebar JS/TS/JSON, custom docs path/sidebar file, multiple sidebars, document IDs distinct from slugs, common numeric filename prefixes, explicit IDs, autogenerated trees, `sidebar_position`, `_category_.json/yml/yaml`, category index documents | Current default docs instance only; versions/locales/plugins are diagnosed. Custom generators and dynamic options need a provider. Generated category pages are unavailable local targets |
| Astro/Starlight | Literal Starlight sidebar, internal slugs, groups/URLs, autogenerate directories, sidebar order/label/hidden, custom slug, Markdown/MDX, `ctx.docs_dir` explicit root | General Astro requires a provider. Locale collections/custom loaders/dynamic Starlight options are unsupported. MDX is treated as text |

Missing documents stay visible as unavailable items and are omitted from next/previous order. Empty declared navigation is a successful empty tree. Unsupported parser syntax produces `unsupported`, missing required files produces `error`, and incomplete static information produces `partial` with diagnostics. Dynamic provider code runs only when registered/selected by user configuration, never by discovering files in a repository.

## Integration contracts

`adapter.parse(ctx)` and `detect.load(path, opts)` return `{status,snapshot?,diagnostics,dependencies,candidates?}`. Candidates preserve ambiguous nearest-root interpretations. Adapters/readers accept `ctx.read(absolute_path) -> lines?`, and directory-based adapters additionally accept `ctx.list(absolute_dir) -> absolute_paths`. Default reads prefer loaded unsaved buffers. All dependency paths are absolute. Detection is synchronous; the UI owns generation checks if scheduling/caching loads.

`index.build(tree)` returns `by_id`, `by_path` (arrays of occurrences), `parent` (parent IDs), and depth-first `order`. `resolve_current(path,{index,selected_id?,history?})` prefers session selection/history then the first occurrence. `breadcrumbs(index,id)` returns ancestors followed by the node. Reading order omits unavailable/external/category nodes, preserves duplicate occurrences, visits a parent's document before children, and never wraps.

`resolver.resolve(raw,{path,root_dir,headings?,snapshot?,read?})` accepts raw Markdown destinations or a NavTarget. Returned document/asset paths are **absolute**, while snapshot targets are root-relative. Query and fragment are split before path percent-decoding. Missing anchors yield unresolved results, never a guessed row. `register_anchor_resolver(adapter,fn)` supplies SSG-specific anchor resolution; the default matches parsed heading `id`/`slug`.

## Primary references checked 2026-10-04

- [mdBook SUMMARY format](https://rust-lang.github.io/mdBook/format/summary.html), rolling official documentation.
- [HonKit configuration](https://honkit.netlify.app/config.html), rolling official documentation.
- [GitBook content configuration](https://gitbook.com/docs/docs-as-code/git-sync/content-configuration), current Git Sync site/space schema.
- [MkDocs configuration](https://www.mkdocs.org/user-guide/configuration/), rolling official documentation.
- [Zensical navigation](https://zensical.org/docs/setup/navigation/) and [project basics](https://zensical.org/docs/setup/basics/), current project TOML/YAML schema.
- [Docusaurus autogenerated sidebars](https://docusaurus.io/docs/sidebar/autogenerated) and [sidebar items](https://docusaurus.io/docs/sidebar/items), documentation version 3.10.2.
- [Starlight sidebar](https://starlight.astro.build/guides/sidebar/) and [configuration](https://starlight.astro.build/reference/configuration/), rolling official documentation.

These URLs establish the inputs tested, not a declaration of complete compatibility with every feature of those generators.
